name: comp-98
title: Animated Plus Toggle
description: A small circular outlined icon button holding a plus. Each click rotates the glyph about 135 degrees with a slight overshoot, so the plus becomes an X and back again.
use: A small square or panel expands from one button and the same control must also close it again.
avoid: It is icon only with no visible text, so the plus needs surrounding context to be understood.
a11y: aria-expanded plus a swapping aria-label explain the state, but the overshoot spin has no reduced-motion fallback. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A thin-bordered dark circle sits on a near-black stage with a slender white plus centred inside. A single line of grey caption text runs beneath it.
behaves: Clicking the circle rotates the plus into an X in about half a second, overshooting a touch before settling; clicking again unwinds it. The fill darkens slightly on hover and focus draws a ring.
customise: No props are exposed: the icon, the easing and the open/close aria labels are written into the file, so reuse means copying and editing it.
weight: light: One button and one rotated icon, with a single transition per click.
